svg.title: Solar panel installer — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as solar panel installer, wearing a safety vest and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A tilted four-cell solar panel rests on a central post and a clearly angled support bracket. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
